records.notes: V2: Rod spikes removed; wall seams backed. Pendant foreground closer to source silhouette; far hanging-lamp arrangement and end-wall depth remain inconsistent. Far seat group too boxy; patterned floor subdued.

V2: Flat mirror discs now lower/wider with ten measured circles; source silhouette broadly reproduced. No seam or portal misses. Seat shared solids no longer intersect but backs remain too high/blocky.
V2: Mirror fit and open service aperture visible; bounded returns give real depth. Recess corner closer to source. Foreground chair shape and lamp rim/profile remain approximate.

V2: V3 restores visible recess return panels after v2 backing-side bug. Major pendant correspondence/order errors remain: some source lamps absent at matching locations. Plant shapes coarse despite fixed branching. Backing incorrectly covered near/return panels; repaired in v3.

V2: V3 restores near-wall panels; no thin depth leaks. Planters same two assemblies; foliage and near-end lamps incomplete. Floor/lighting weaker than source. Backing incorrectly covered near/return panels; repaired in v3.
V2: Desk intrusion largely removed while keeping source-camera projection. Window door frames thicker, still too stylized. Lamp ordering remains imperfect.
V2: Desk front-left silhouette aligns better; source planters/seat positions still differ. Floor reflections overly smooth and lamp shape/order unresolved.
V2: Desk improved but own DA3 discrepancy persists; column and plants remain approximate. No shell-gap misses.
V2: Dominant foreground pendant moved into correct source location. Far lamps remain partly mismatched; seated forms and planters simplified. Desk DA3 residual worsens despite RGB corner agreement.
V2: Forward view confirms corrected rods and supported shell; source pattern, seating backs and vegetation still approximate. End-wall prediction conflict remains pronounced.
